preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID every day — required at Interchange pantries and Jewish Community Pantry.
Tell every pantry you have no kitchen and need no-cook or ready-to-eat items.
Call older listings (mfc-*) before traveling: hours were last verified in 2024.
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) to confirm no appointment is needed before your first visit.
Call St. Vincent de Paul (Cross Roads: 414-649-9555 / Harambee: 414-249-3866) to confirm cost and any entry rules.
For Saturday/Sunday gaps, call 211 (dial 2-1-1) for same-day Milwaukee food resources.
Salvation Army Citadel (414-463-3300) lists Thu/Fri hours — call Monday to confirm if open that day.
Keep any pantry items that don't need refrigeration together; you have refrigeration available for perishables.
